label: Visit
description: A made-up identifier, one per visit

label: Date of visit
description: The day the visit began, YYYY-MM-DD

label: Facility
description: One of three made-up emergency departments

label: Age
description: Age in completed years, within the age group

label: Sex
description: F or M, as recorded at triage

label: Chief complaint
description: Free text as triage wrote it: abbreviated, sometimes misspelled

label: Discharge diagnosis (ICD-10)
description: WHO ICD-10 codes, separated by semicolons; empty where none was received

label: Discharge diagnosis (ICD-11)
description: ICD-11 codes (2026-01), separated by semicolons; the same diagnoses as the ICD-10 column

label: Discharge diagnosis (SNOMED CT)
description: SNOMED CT concept identifiers from SNOMED International's Global Patient Set, separated by semicolons

label: Diagnosis received
description: The day the discharge diagnosis reached the feed, YYYY-MM-DD
